thresholds.PASS_REQUIREMENT: PARENT_PERCENTILE >= 0.95 AND DELTA_CLUSTER_CI95_LOW_R > 0 AND REFERENCE_COVERAGE >= 0.90 AND PARENT_N >= 30

decisions.title: OPPORTUNITY UNIT
decisions.question: What is the atomic opportunity unit for clustering, null sampling, and inference?
decisions.recommended_value: ONE_SESSION_OPPORTUNITY_PER_SYMBOL_DAY_SESSION — one opportunity cluster per (symbol, day, session); LONG and SHORT reference legs attach to the same cluster and are never sampled as independent observations.
alternatives: per-event-bar units
per-day units collapsing sessions
decisions.evidence: ALD V2 opportunity identity in the frozen replay; R3.1 clustered inference; R3.2 one-leg null membership audit (one leg per opportunity per draw).
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Under-clustering inflates effective sample size and narrows confidence intervals; over-clustering discards information.

decisions.title: CAUSAL_ENTRY_GEOMETRY_MASK_V1
decisions.question: Which selection mask defines the parent population?
decisions.recommended_value: CAUSAL_ENTRY_GEOMETRY_MASK_V1 — S1–S6 plus entry/stop/target geometry, every input carrying available_at <= T2; S9, future-bar existence, right-censor status, MFE/MAE, realized outcome, and future fill knowledge are forbidden inputs.
alternatives: historical row.all_rules_pass — REJECTED, embeds S9 outcome information
historical S7/S8 freeze — REJECTED as-is because S7 depends on the existence of forward M5 bars after confirmation
decisions.evidence: R3.2 selection-time audit (s8_entry_eligible_n = 294, s9_completed_n = 294, all-rules-pass requires S9); artifacts/funnel_optimizer_v1_r3_causal_policy_freeze/causal_mask_audit.json.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: A leaking mask admits post-entry information into selection and manufactures eligibility (the R3.1 failure mode).

decisions.title: T2_DECISION_TIME
decisions.question: When is the final parent decision deemed knowable?
decisions.recommended_value: T2_DECISION_TIME = CONFIRMATION_M5_CLOSE (confirming M5 bar open + 5 minutes).
alternatives: event open T0 — REJECTED, direction not yet known (R3.2: 294/294 noncausal)
T1 direction availability — insufficient, confirmation not yet observed
decisions.evidence: R3.2 timing ledger; m15_direction_available_time and t2_decision_time in ag_edgelab.optimization.causal_time.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: An earlier T2 admits direction/confirmation lookahead into the parent estimand.

decisions.title: NEXT_BAR_EXECUTION_RULE
decisions.question: How is the executable reference entry timed?
decisions.recommended_value: REFERENCE_EXECUTABLE_ENTRY = FIRST_M5_OPEN_AT_OR_AFTER_T2 — never the confirmation bar itself.
alternatives: confirmation close price entry (same-bar) — rejected, not executable at decision
T2 + fixed offset — rejected, ignores the bar schedule
decisions.evidence: first_m5_open_at_or_after implementation; the R3.1 defect was entries preceding direction availability by 15 minutes.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Same-bar entry quietly credits the strategy with prices it could not transact.

decisions.title: BASELINE_T2_TIMING_POLICY
decisions.question: How are non-parent baseline opportunities' reference entries timed in the causal T2 estimand?
decisions.recommended_value: NONE — this is the explicitly unresolved decision.
alternatives: A = EMPIRICAL_MATCHED_DELAY — deterministic hash-slot into the sorted parent T2−T0 lag distribution (R3.2 diagnostic semantics)
B = STRATIFIED_EMPIRICAL_MATCHED_DELAY — same, stratified by symbol + session, and by year where the stratum has >= 30 parents
C = FIXED_CAUSAL_DELAY_FROM_T1 — one preregistered clock (120 minutes from T1) that does not depend on whether the opportunity later qualifies
decisions.evidence: The three-policy sensitivity table in baseline_timing_sensitivity.json (POLICY_SENSITIVITY_ANALYSIS, not candidate optimization). The current R3.2 baseline (DETERMINISTIC_MATCHED_EMPIRICAL_T2_MINUS_T0_LAG_FOR_NONPARENT_UNIVERSE) was an adversarial diagnostic and is NOT yet owner authority.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: A baseline timing choice that systematically over/under-credits the baseline shifts the percentile and delta CI and can flip an eligibility verdict; the choice must not be made by looking at which policy makes a strategy pass.

decisions.title: PRIMARY_DIRECTIONAL_NULL
decisions.question: What is the primary null for directional eligibility?
decisions.recommended_value: RANDOM_DIRECTION_ONE_LEG_PER_OPPORTUNITY — one direction per opportunity per draw, deterministic preregistered RNG, never averaging LONG+SHORT into one null observation.
alternatives: OLD_SYMMETRIC_TWO_LEG_AVERAGE — RETIRED as eligibility authority (R3.2: SD 0.039829R vs 0.083890R, materially understated variance); retained only as a historical diagnostic
Robustness null MATCHED_DIRECTION_FREQUENCY_NULL — kept as the secondary, direction-frequency-preserving check
decisions.risk_if_wrong: An understated null variance inflates parent percentiles and manufactures passes.

decisions.title: REFERENCE_COVERAGE_MIN
decisions.question: Minimum evaluable reference-outcome coverage?
alternatives: 0.80 (looser)
0.95 (stricter)
decisions.evidence: Carried unchanged from the R3/R3.1 proposed policies; R3 historical coverage was 100%.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Too low permits selection-survivor coverage bias; too high blocks legitimate candidates near data boundaries.

decisions.title: PARENT_PERCENTILE_MIN
decisions.question: Minimum parent percentile against the primary null?
decisions.evidence: Carried unchanged from the R3/R3.1 proposed policies; pass additionally requires DELTA_CLUSTER_CI95_LOW_R > 0.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Lower thresholds admit weaker parents under multiple testing; higher thresholds reduce power.

decisions.title: BOOTSTRAP_CLUSTER_AND_REPLICATES
decisions.question: Resampling unit and replicate count?
decisions.recommended_value: BOOTSTRAP_CLUSTER_UNIT = OPPORTUNITY, BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES = 2000, NULL_REPLICATES = 2000 (minimum 1000), NULL_MASTER_SEED = 4030341158 with deterministic per-campaign derivation, frozen BEFORE any GEN3 evaluation.
alternatives: 1000 replicates (the stated minimum)
larger counts only if preregistered runtime evidence demands
decisions.evidence: R3.1 clustered bootstrap; R3.2 used 2000 replicates; directional_null_policy.FrozenNullPolicy.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Leg-level resampling breaks clustering; too few replicates makes percentile/CI estimates noisy.

decisions.title: MIN_PARENT_N
decisions.question: Minimum parent sample size?
decisions.evidence: Carried unchanged from the R3/R3.1 proposed policies.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Too small enables small-sample percentile artifacts; too large starves legitimate parents.

decisions.title: REFERENCE_ATR_POLICY
decisions.question: Reference stop distance authority?
decisions.recommended_value: ATR(14) on completed M5 bars before entry × 1.0 (REFERENCE_ATR_PERIOD = 14, REFERENCE_ATR_MULTIPLE = 1.0).
alternatives: other periods/multiples — none considered; changing them after seeing GEN3 performance is forbidden
decisions.evidence: reference_outcome_v2._atr_before (true ranges end strictly before the entry bar); carried unchanged from R3.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: ATR computed including the entry bar leaks the entry candle into the stop distance.

decisions.title: REFERENCE_TARGET_R
decisions.question: Reference target multiple?
decisions.evidence: Carried unchanged from R3; identical for candidate and null.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Asymmetric target/stop geometry changes the baseline path expectancy (the symmetric 2R/1R model is not algebraically zero).

decisions.title: REFERENCE_TIMEOUT
decisions.question: Reference outcome horizon?
decisions.recommended_value: REFERENCE_MAX_HOLDING_M5_BARS = 72 (6 hours), timeout exit at horizon close.
alternatives: 288 bars (ALD V2 natural horizon — different model)
144 bars
decisions.evidence: Carried unchanged from R3; identical for candidate and null.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: A horizon shorter than typical stop/target resolution converts geometric outcomes into unresolved timeouts.

decisions.title: INTRABAR_TIE_POLICY
decisions.question: When one bar touches both stop and target?
alternatives: optimistic target-first — rejected
drop ambiguous rows selectively — rejected (R2 fixture fails closed with AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR instead)
decisions.evidence: reference_outcome_v2._one_direction; R2 fixture AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR fail-closed handling.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Optimistic tie resolution systematically overstates expectancy.

decisions.title: ALD_FAMILY_DISPOSITION
decisions.question: What happens to the ALD V2 family?
decisions.recommended_value: ALD_V2_DEV_SELECTION_STATUS = DEV_REJECTED_CAUSAL_SELECTION, ALD_FAMILY_DISPOSITION = ARCHIVE_NO_V2_2 — no causal DEV selection evidence, no OOS conclusion, no claim of globally proven NO_EDGE, and no further ALD V2 optimization on this DEVELOPMENT evidence. All artifacts preserved immutably.
alternatives: define V2.2 on the same DEV partition — rejected (post-hoc search on consumed evidence)
treat R3.1 PASS as valid — rejected (R3.2 classified it R3_1_PASS_EXPLAINED_BY_MULTIPLE_ARTIFACTS)
decisions.evidence: config/governance/ald_v2_disposition.json; appended clarifications in config/governance/candidate_ledger.json; frozen ALD V2 SHA256 883e9095977cd25840201f5b2b3d5ce6e67b350c1157f30045654dbd13904920.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: Continuing the family on this partition reuses direction-timing information already observed.

decisions.title: MAX_CHILDREN_PER_PARENT
decisions.question: Multiple-testing search budget per parent?
decisions.recommended_value: MAX_CHILDREN_PER_PARENT = 100, with counting rules: every tested child counts, rejected children count, failed code-valid trials count once evaluated, no reset between rounds. OWNER_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED = TRUE; optimization may begin only after PARENT_DEV_ACCEPTANCE = PASS AND OWNER_R3_POLICY_AUTHORIZED = TRUE; no rescue by OOS.
alternatives: 50 (stricter)
200 (looser)
decisions.evidence: Multiple-testing section of the policy proposal; GEN3 draft requires preregistered mutation budgets.
decisions.risk_if_wrong: An uncounted or resettable budget silently inflates the family-wise false-pass rate.
